units.source_text: 我早有所闻，今天对弈者都不回家，从红叶馆一起出发，到箱根旅馆去。

en.t: I had heard about it beforehand: today the players would not go home, but would leave together from the Momijikan and go to the inn in Hakone.

units.source_text: 但七段这件大行李有点异样。

en.t: But this large piece of luggage belonging to the seventh-dan player seemed a little unusual.
